_A_TOOLTIP_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: ATooltip displays additional information when the user hovers over or focuses an element.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_TAG_DESCRIPTION_: You can change the HTML tag used for the tooltip trigger element.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_MAX_WIDTH_DESCRIPTION_: Limits the maximum width of the tooltip content.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_WIDTH_DESCRIPTION_: Sets a fixed width for the tooltip content.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_TIME_CLOSE_DESCRIPTION_: Controls how long the tooltip remains visible after the pointer leaves the trigger or tooltip area.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_HIDE_ARROW_DESCRIPTION_: The tooltip arrow can be hidden.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_OFFSET_SKIDDING_DESCRIP: Moves the tooltip along the reference element axis.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_OFFSET_DISTANCE_DESCRIP: Changes the distance between the tooltip and the trigger element.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_ARROW_PADDING_DESCRIPTI: Sets the padding that limits how close the arrow can get to the tooltip edges.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_ARROW_PADDING_FUNCTION_: Arrow padding can also be calculated dynamically with a callback function.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_ARROW_PADDING_DESCRIPTI: Minimum distance in px between the arrow and the edges of the tooltip. A function receives the sizes and returns the number.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_ID_DESCRIPTION_: ID of the tooltip. The element gets aria-describedby with this ID.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_IS_HIDE_DESCRIPTION_: The tooltip is not shown, only the content of the default slot. Closes an open tooltip.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_MAX_WIDTH_DESCRIPTION_: Maximum width of the tooltip. A number is in px, a string is used as it is.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_MIN_WIDTH_DESCRIPTION_: Minimum width of the tooltip. A number is in px, a string is used as it is.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_OFFSET_DISTANCE_DESCRIP: Distance in px between the tooltip and the element.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_OFFSET_SKIDDING_DESCRIP: Shift in px of the tooltip along the element.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_PLACEMENT_DESCRIPTION_: Position of the tooltip relative to the element, e.g. top, bottom, left, right, top-start.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_POPPER_CONTAINER_ID_DES: ID of the container at the end of the body in which the tooltip is rendered.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_SHOW_ARROW_DESCRIPTION_: Shows the arrow of the tooltip.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_TAG_DESCRIPTION_: HTML tag of the element around the default slot.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_TIME_CLOSE_DESCRIPTION_: Time in ms before the tooltip closes after the pointer leaves the element or the tooltip.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_WIDTH_DESCRIPTION_: Fixed width of the tooltip. A number is in px, a string is used as it is (e.g. "20rem").
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_WITHOUT_ARIA_DESCRIBEDB: The element does not get aria-describedby, e.g. if the text of the tooltip is already read otherwise.
_A_TOOLTIP_SLOT_DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION_: The element that shows the tooltip on hover and focus.
_A_TOOLTIP_A11Y_DESCRIPTION_: Put the tooltip only on an element that can get the focus (a button, a link, a form field) or use tag="button": then it opens with the mouse and with the keyboard, and the focused element gets aria-describedby. A tooltip has no links or buttons: it disappears when the mouse leaves; use ADropdown or a modal for them. Escape closes only the tooltip.
_A_TOOLTIP_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: The tooltip opens on mouse hover and when the button gets the focus. The button gets aria-describedby with the text of the tooltip, so a screen reader reads it after the name of the button.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_PLACEMENT_DESCRIPTION_: placement sets the side of the tooltip. If there is not enough space, it goes to the other side.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_ICON_BUTTON_DESCRIPTION: The name of the button comes from aria-label, the tooltip shows it to sighted users. without-aria-describedby prevents a screen reader from reading the same text twice. For buttons also AButton with title and is-title-html works.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_TIME_OPEN_DESCRIPTION_: time-open waits so many ms before the tooltip opens on mouse hover, so tooltips do not flicker when the mouse moves over many elements. The focus opens the tooltip at once.
_A_TOOLTIP_GROUP_IS_HIDE_DESCRIPTION_: is-hide switches the tooltip off and closes it when it is open, e.g. when a text is not shortened and the tooltip would repeat it.
_A_TOOLTIP_PROPS_TIME_OPEN_DESCRIPTION_: Delay in ms before the tooltip opens on mouse hover. The focus opens it at once.
